author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
Ellie receives an unexpected Birthday Surprise on her 30th birthday. In this suspenseful sketch, we explore the pressure of a late ADHD diagnosis and the horror of being expected to wear a positive mask. Made with the support of NZ On Air.

Check out Ellies Podcast, WTF is AuDHD! - https://linktr.ee/wtfisaudhdpodcast

If you're struggling with your mental health, please seek help. Here are some worldwide resources that could help: 
https://movember.com/mens-health/get-support 
https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories/mental-well-being-resources-for-the-public https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_suicide_crisis_lines https://unitedgmh.org/mental-health-support
https://www.helpguide.org/find-help.htm
